description: Self-hosted Renovate (renovate CI job). See docs/RENOVATE.md.

gitlabci.description: CI job images come pinned by digest (tag@sha256), as the CI image class of the auto-merge policy requires (docs/AUTOMERGE.md, "CI images"). Unpinned images get a one-off pin MR

customManagers.description: docker/docker-compose.yml is a Jinja template (rendered by ansible), so the docker-compose manager cannot parse it; read its tag@digest image lines directly
Global npm installs pinned in Dockerfiles, e.g. npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@x.y.z
Annotated pins: a '# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name> [versioning=<v>] [extractVersion=<re>]' comment on the line above 'key: value' or KEY="value"
Default images of the GitLab runners (base/gitlab-runner/config.toml, TOML: image = "name:tag@digest")

packageRules.description: Router compose file: its own branches, so an MR there changes one image in one file and the auto-merge policy can evaluate it
linuxserver.io build suffixes (-lsNNN) are part of the version, not a flavor
Plex tags end in a build hash
Floating-tag digest refreshes: batch them to once a week
Compose files no host renders (docker_compose_file_names in ansible/inventory.yml): nothing would deploy or health-check an update there. zigbee2mqtt runs from docker/docker-compose.yml
Images used only by services under the retired `wordpress` compose profile (blog, wordpress_db). A per-service deploy would start them, so they are not updated (docs/AUTOMERGE.md)

Auto-merge class (docs/AUTOMERGE.md): non-major updates in the deployed compose files, which the auto-merge sweep merges on its own. Proposed daily (digest refreshes too) and outside the MR limits, so updates waiting for a human (majors, GitLab) cannot hold them back. Excludes the denylisted images and the images whose update kinds are restricted; keep in sync with ci/automerge-policy.yml (checked by ci/automerge/test_fast_track.py)

CI image class (docs/AUTOMERGE.md, "CI images"): non-major updates of job images in .gitlab-ci.yml, which the auto-merge sweep merges on its own. Proposed daily and outside the MR limits, like the compose auto-merge class. Excludes the denylisted images and ci_images.denylist; keep in sync with ci/automerge-policy.yml (checked by ci/automerge/test_ci_images.py)

CI image denylist (docs/AUTOMERGE.md, "CI images"): the sweep never merges updates of these CI job images. Labelled so the pending update stays visible; keep in sync with ci_images.denylist in ci/automerge-policy.yml (checked by ci/automerge/test_ci_images.py)
prBodyNotes: **Manual merge.** This CI image is on the CI image denylist (`ci/automerge-policy.yml`, reason there), so the sweep will not merge it.

packageRules.description: Dependency class (docs/AUTOMERGE.md, "Dependency updates"): .gitlab-ci.yml job image updates get their own branches, so a CI job image bump never shares an MR with a Dockerfile base image bump of the same image (the auto-merge policy refuses mixed MRs)

Dependency class, security-critical images (dependencies.security_critical.files in ci/automerge-policy.yml): their own branches, with patch releases apart from minors, since the sweep merges only their digest and patch updates. Keep in sync with the policy (checked by ci/automerge/test_dependency_class.py)
Dependency class, security-critical images: a minor update waits for a human. Labelled so it stays visible
prBodyNotes: **Manual merge.** This image is security-critical (`dependencies.security_critical` in `ci/automerge-policy.yml`): the sweep merges only its digest and patch updates.

packageRules.description: Dependency class (docs/AUTOMERGE.md, "Dependency updates"): non-major updates of Dockerfile base images and version pins, the OpenClaw tool npm dependencies and annotated ansible version pins, which the auto-merge sweep merges on its own. Proposed daily and outside the MR limits, like the compose and CI image classes. Excludes the denylisted images; keep in sync with ci/automerge-policy.yml (checked by ci/automerge/test_dependency_class.py)

Dependency class denylist: the sweep never merges these base image updates. Labelled so the pending update stays visible; keep in sync with dependencies.denylist in ci/automerge-policy.yml (checked by ci/automerge/test_dependency_class.py)
prBodyNotes: **Manual merge.** This base image is on the dependency class denylist (`ci/automerge-policy.yml`, reason there), so the sweep will not merge it.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge denylist (docs/AUTOMERGE.md): the sweep never merges these. Labelled so the pending update stays visible; keep in sync with denylist.images in ci/automerge-policy.yml (checked by ci/automerge/test_fast_track.py)
prBodyNotes: **Manual merge.** This image is on the auto-merge denylist (`ci/automerge-policy.yml`, reason there), so the sweep will not merge it. See "GitLab updates" in docs/AUTOMERGE.md before merging a GitLab update.

packageRules.description: Locally built images (pushed by CI) have no upstream to track
Nextcloud's MariaDB stays on the 12.3 LTS series (patch and digest updates only). Changing series is a manual migration, see the comment in docker/docker-compose.yml
promtail >= 3.6 dropped journal support in the published image
shairport-sync 5.6.1 and 5.6.2 exit when a classic AirPlay sender offers a format they cannot decode (pyatv sends L16), taking the receiver down; 5.6/5.6.0 untested and skipped too (docs/AUDIO.md)
influxdb 3 is a different product (storage engine and query language)
linuxserver/deluge has pre-2.x tags (e.g. 18.04.1) from an old scheme
virtio-win: Fedora archive directory names are <version>-<release>
prBodyNotes: Fedora publishes no checksum for this ISO: update `sha256` in the same file by hand (`curl -fsSL <url> | sha256sum`) before merging.

packageRules.description: OpenClaw is moltbot itself: labelled. Its base image (ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw) is always reviewed (dependencies.denylist); its tool npm dependencies and pinned CLIs go through the dependency class of the auto-merge policy

Ollama must keep a CUDA 12 runner: the Quadro P5000 is Pascal (compute 6.1), which CUDA 13 dropped, so an image without lib/ollama/cuda_v12 silently runs on the CPU. Updates wait for approval on the dependency dashboard; test them as in docs/ollama.md
prBodyNotes: Pascal GPU check before merging (docs/ollama.md): the new image must still ship `/usr/lib/ollama/cuda_v12`, and with `OLLAMA_DEBUG=1` the log must show `inference compute ... library=CUDA compute=6.1` and `ollama ps` must show `100% GPU`.

packageRules.description: Frigate: a 0.x minor release migrates frigate.db one way and bumps the config file version; the auto-merge policy treats 0.x minors as majors, so they wait for review. Patches and digest refreshes go through the sweep. See docs/frigate.md (Upgrades)
prBodyNotes: **Frigate** (docs/frigate.md, Upgrades): for a minor (0.x) release, set `version:` in `docker/frigate/config.yml` to the new `CURRENT_CONFIG_VERSION`, check the release notes for config changes, copy `frigate.db` first, and check that the `-tensorrt` image still ships CUDA 12 (the P5000 is Pascal, compute 6.1).

packageRules.description: Fast track (docs/AUTOMERGE.md): patch releases of these images get their own MR even when a minor release is also available, so the patch does not wait for the minor's review

Fast track (docs/AUTOMERGE.md): digest refreshes and patch releases of these images are proposed at any hour and outside the MR limits; the auto-merge sweep merges them once the MR pipeline passes. Keep this list identical to fast_track.images in ci/automerge-policy.yml (checked by ci/automerge/test_fast_track.py)
